<details><summary>AI review</summary>

Reviewed at c905db3 (with web-platform-tests/wpt#64665 at f735fbf)

The rule matches Chromium (`SelectionLogic` behind the stable `SrcsetSelectionMatchesImageSet` flag), Gecko (`ResponsiveImageSelector::SelectImage`) and WebKit (`pickBestImageCandidate`). The new preload `Assert` holds, since early hints never set a source set.

**Suggestions**

- `source:33865-33868`: Would be nice to call a named algorithm instead of invoking a getter here. CSSOM View exports [determine the device pixel ratio](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#determine-the-device-pixel-ratio), but it takes no document (it reads "the current page zoom"). Maybe give it a document parameter there and call that? That would also drop the new Web IDL "getter steps" dependency.
- `source:33865-33868`: Which zoom counts isn't obvious. Consider a note saying the `zoom` property on the `img` element or its ancestors doesn't affect selection, but `zoom` on an `iframe` does, through the child document's `devicePixelRatio`. Chrome Canary and Firefox Nightly behave this way (in Firefox, `zoom: 2` on the `img`, an ancestor, or the root element doesn't change the selection; in an `iframe` with `zoom: 2`, the child's `devicePixelRatio` doubles and the 2x candidate wins). Safari TP doubles the child's `devicePixelRatio` but ignores it for selection, which is WebKit bug 301807.
- `select-an-image-source.html:331,435,475`, `preload-imagesrcset-selection.html:197`, `select-an-image-source-zoom.html:97-99`, `select-an-image-source-cached.optional.html:71,257`: `Math.round(100 * dpr)` can round down and leave the "match" candidate's density just below DPR. At DPR 1.1 (actually 1.100000023841858, from float), 110w/100px = 1.1 < DPR, so the next candidate wins. Consider `Math.ceil` for widths that are meant to be ≥ DPR.
- `select-an-image-source-cached.optional.html:161,197,213,248,270,308`: the "keeps already-loaded …" tests wait 50ms and then assert nothing changed, so they also pass in a UA that never reselects or is slow to. For the attribute-change cases, consider asserting `img.complete` after a task: selection happens at a stable state, so a new pending request would already show. The zoom case is "may at any time", so it can't be made deterministic.

**Nits**

- `source:33846`: "For each image source *entry* in *sourceSet*" should be "of".
- `source:33402` vs `source:34443`: the two call sites unpack the tuple differently (`Set … to selected[0] and … selected[1]` vs `Let (selected source, selected pixel density) be selected`). Consider using one form.
- `select-an-image-source.html:282`: "0x descriptor is valid" isn't right. The authoring grammar requires > 0; the parser just doesn't drop it. Maybe "0x descriptor is parsed".
- `select-an-image-source.html`: the CSS zoom test only puts `zoom` on the `img` itself. If the note above is added, consider an ancestor-`zoom` case too.

</details>

(I reviewed using [spec-pr-review](https://github.com/whatwg/spec-ai/pull/9); D1 and D2 dropped locally and applied D3-D5. Q1 was about `complete` which has known spec bugs, keeping the test as-is.)

D3: The new note said `zoom` on the `img` or its ancestors "therefore does not affect image source selection", but it can through `sizes=auto`: with `zoom: 2` on the `img` or an ancestor, Firefox Nightly and Safari TP pick the wider candidate and Chrome Canary doesn't. Fixed in fa2e81c3 by dropping that clause, so the note only says `zoom` doesn't affect `devicePixelRatio`. Whether `sizes=auto` should use the zoomed width seems like a separate issue.

D4: "cached src attribute is excluded from source set when srcset already has a 1x descriptor" set the cached `src` before `srcset`, so update the image data took the list of available images path and fired `load` for `src` (Firefox Nightly's result, which seems correct per spec). Fixed in https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/commit/889e54736a21ba317de2886b2da1ffd168c0373f by setting `srcset` first.

D5: "dynamic zoom change updates devicePixelRatio and re-selects x-descriptor image source" tested reacting to environment changes, which is a "may", in a non-optional file, and waited on `load` with no timeout, so it stalled the file in Safari TP. Fixed in https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/commit/bf4517cff2796fcce28bf3c08f3e0e324e5c99b1 by moving it to `select-an-image-source-zoom-change.optional.html` with a `t.step_wait()` timeout.

<details><summary>Reviewed commits</summary>

Reviewed at 7bdd8ae on 01f5b54, with web-platform-tests/wpt#64665 at 2028190, using spec-pr-review.
</details>
